name: hvacbuilder.app
description: HVAC Builder is an engineering tool for custom HVAC systems: assemble coils, compressors, fans, pumps, packs and exchangers into a system, solve the thermodynamic balance at a design point, run it against a year of real weather, or model a whole building with rooms, schedules and several machines. The connector gives an AI agent the same account you have: it can design or compose a system from the catalog's thousands of manufacturer-published compressor maps, solve it, fetch TMY weather, simulate a year or a building, save and publish designs, and — for suppliers — fit AHRI 540 maps from rating tables and import a product range. Read-only tools run without confirmation; the few that update or delete are marked destructive. Free tier to design and solve; simulations on paid tiers or the example building's free daily runs.

_published_faq.name: How do I add hvacbuilder.app to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add hvacbuilder.app to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://hvacbuilder.app/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the hvacbuilder.app MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: hvacbuilder.app lists 39 MCP tools, including create_weather_dataset, delete_building, delete_saved_system, fetch_tmy_weather, fit_compressor_map, get_building, get_catalog_item, get_saved_system, get_supplier_preset, import_catalog_items, import_weather_csv, and list_buildings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to hvacbuilder.app?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to hvacbuilder.app in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
hvacbuilder.app requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
hvacbuilder.app is developed by Myron Van Staden. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
